title: Father's Remnants
next_chapter_hook: Just as the candlelight in the secret chamber flickered uncertainly, an aged yet familiar voice rang out behind Chen Ji: 'You've finally come, child. There are things I wished to bury forever...'

text.content: The blurred image in the Jade Slip seared Chen Ji's consciousness like a branding iron. Chen Nian was imprisoned within a pitch-black Void, golden chains coiled behind him—the exact style of those chains matching the patterns along the edge of the Tianji Record Fragment. He gripped the Jade Slip so tightly his knuckles turned white, his chest heaving violently. Three breaths later, the cowardly facade of his waste identity settled back over his features, but the hand clutching the Jade Slip never loosened. 'Sister...' he murmured, voice so hoarse it felt foreign even to himself. What Ye Qing gave him wasn't just a clue, but also these words: 'Your father once investigated the origin of the Tianji Record as well. His death is connected to this.'

At the third quarter of the Midnight Hour, the moon hidden behind clouds. Chen Ji, dressed in nightclothes, moved silently through the ruins of the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain. This was his father Chen Xuan's former residence, turned into forbidden grounds after his accidental death when Chen Ji was twelve. The entire sect claimed Chen Xuan died from cultivation deviation, but only Chen Ji knew—the death was no accident. Three years of scheming, living as atrash servant in the sect—all for this day. Beneath his feet, withered leaves crumbled silently. His gaze swept across the desolate courtyard, finally landing on a bluish brick in the corner of the East Wing that was slightly darker than the others.

dialogue.content: 'This is the place.' Chen Ji crouched down, brushing his fingertips across that bluish brick. It appeared identical to ordinary stones on the surface, but when his spiritual energy permeated it, an almost imperceptible fluctuation came from beneath. A faint smile tugged at his lips—his father had indeed left a backup plan. Exactly as Ye Qing had said, the entrance to the underground secret chamber was hidden within a hidden compartment in his father's bedroom. Had it not been for the demonic path technique that could sense that deliberately concealed aura, he might have searched for another decade without finding it.

text.content: The bluish brick sank three inches with a click, and a hidden door slid open in the wall—barely wide enough for one person. A musty smell rushed out, tinged with faint sandalwood—the incense his father had always used, still not dissipated after ten years. Chen Ji's nose tingled with酸涩, but he suppressed the emotion into his heart's depths. He took a deep breath, sideways squeezed into the hidden passage. The narrow tunnel extended downward about twenty zhang, faint yellowish light glinting at its end. His steps were extremely light, each one precisely avoiding any stone slab crevices that might make sound.

At the end of the tunnel was a secret chamber barely three zhang square. The four walls were cast in bronze, covered with dense符文—ancient sealing formation variants, sufficient to block any spiritual perception. The chamber's furnishings were extremely simple: one stone table, one ever-burning lamp, and several yellowed bamboo scrolls neatly arranged on the table. However, what truly made Chen Ji's pupils constrict was the silk-bound book pressed at the very bottom in the center of the stone table. The three ancient seal characters on the cover smashed into his vision like thunder—'Tianji Annotation'.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji's hand hovered above the book, trembling slightly. He recognized this calligraphy—this was his father's writing. Carefully unfurling the silk, what met his eyes were tiny regular characters, neat but with a hint of urgency, clearly written in extreme haste. The first line read: 'The Tianji Record is not an artifact, but a shackle. All holders throughout the ages have met unfortunate ends. I glimpsed this secret through a fragment, yet it was too late...' Chen Ji's breathing suddenly grew rapid.

text.content: He forcibly suppressed the surging emotions, reading page by page. 'The Tianji Record has been transmitted for a thousand years, with a total of seventy-three recorded holders. Among them, thirty-one went mad, nineteen died suddenly, twelve disappeared, seven destroyed their spiritual consciousness, and four went mad then regained sanity before dying of old age. Only one person can barely be called having a good end—' The next page. '—the third-generation holder, Murong Qingcheng. He severed the Tianji's pull through great wisdom and great willpower, finally gaining autonomy over life and death. However, the price was that the Tianji Record became incomplete from then on, the transmission broken, until this one page in my hands.'

Chen Ji's fingertips brushed across those characters, a bone-deep chill rising in his heart. Seventy-three holders, none had a good end. He had always thought he held a heaven-defying opportunity to change his fate, yet from the very beginning, he was merely another sacrifice about to walk toward destruction. But what chilled him even more was the next passage: 'Each additional fragment of the Tianji Record deepens the holder's connection with the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. I suspect that the so-called Tianji Record is the sensory organ through which Heavenly Mandate's will projects into the mortal world. The stronger the holder becomes, the more their fate is devoured by the Heavenly Mandate...'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji abruptly flipped to the last few pages. The handwriting became increasingly sloppy, the strokes revealing the desperation and resolve of a dying person: 'I have already investigated—Ling Yuan, the current sect master of Tianqing Sect, has long colluded with the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. He needs Tianji Record holders to constantly confirm Heavenly Mandate prophecies to consolidate his power position. After my death, he will surely come here to destroy the evidence—' The writing stopped abruptly here. The last three pages had been torn out by someone, leaving only jagged paper edges and old bloodstains.

text.content: Bloodstains. That was his father's blood. Chen Ji stared at those several dark reddish-brown marks, feeling as if an invisible hand was crushing his chest. He could imagine the scene when his father wrote these words in this place years ago—a person who discovered a shocking truth, at the most desperate moment, had his final心血 torn away, and then... Then was silenced. 'Ling Yuan...' Chen Ji murmured this name, his voice terrifyingly calm, 'So it was you.'

His fingertips gently brushed across the bloodstains, the touch cold and sticky. The blood had long dried into a scar, yet it seemed to still carry his father's final moments. Ten years. He had survived ten years astrash beneath his enemy's nose, all for waiting for one opportunity. Now, the evidence was before his eyes, the killer's name carved into his heart. But he also saw one thing clearly—with his current strength, wanting to shake Ling Yuan was no different from an egg shattering against a rock. Furthermore, behind Ling Yuan stood that so-called 'Eye of Heavenly Secrets'. Impulse, or patience?

choice.prompt: His father's bloodstains were right before his eyes, the killer's name already exposed. This moment Chen Ji faced a choice—whether to take this evidence and leave immediately, planning carefully; or while things were hot, continue searching the secret chamber for other clues his father left behind?

choices.text: Take the notes and retreat immediately
choices.description: The evidence is in hand, the target is clear. Now is not the time to stir up trouble; we should retreat safely and plan carefully. Ling Yuan is scheming and experienced; any misstep means total defeat.
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily abandon the opportunity for in-depth investigation
choices.visible_reward: Preserve existing clues and avoid exposure
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan has already sensed the intrusion into the secret chamber, he may have set an ambush
choices.process_label: chen ji hides notes close, about to return same way

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, carefully tucking the silk-bound book into his chest. The truth his father traded his life for, he would never let it be destroyed by his own hands. Just as he turned to leave— The ever-burning lamp's flame suddenly shifted from yellow to green, an icy chill pouring in from all directions. The formation runes in the secret chamber lit up on their own, glowing with eerie golden light. 'Since you've come, why hurry to leave?' An aged yet familiar voice rang out behind Chen Ji, like cold wind from the Nine Abysses pouring into his ears. Chen Ji's pupils constricted—this voice, he had heard for three full years. Ling Yuan. He slowly turned around, meeting those fathomless eyes. The old man's face remained kind and gentle, even wearing a faint smile, as if casually greeting a junior. 'Ji'er, visiting your father's former residence in the middle of the night—is something bothering you?'

choices.text: Continue searching the secret chamber for clues
choices.description: His father must have left more backup plans before death. This is a rare once-in-a-millennium opportunity; even with risks, we must thoroughly uncover all the truth.
choices.visible_cost: May trigger the secret chamber's mechanisms and alert enemies
choices.risk_hint: There may be unknown dangers hidden in the secret chamber
choices.process_label: chen ji risks continued search, fingers reaching under stone altar

text.content:
Chen Ji did not leave.

He squatted down and reached into the hidden compartment beneath the stone altar. His fingertips touched cold metal—a mechanism lock. He twisted it forcefully, and the hidden compartment sprang open, revealing an ancient jade pendant and a letter sealed with wax.

The jade pendant was warm and smooth as water, engraved with the character "Ji," the very item his father had always carried. On the letter were four characters: "For My Son's Eyes Only."

Chen Ji's hands trembled violently.

Just as he was about to unseal the envelope, the eternal lamp in the secret chamber suddenly went out. Runes on the four walls blazed with blinding golden light, and a vast pressure descended like a mountain.

"Your father indeed left you with contingencies."

The voice came from the darkness, calm and indifferent, yet it nearly froze Chen Ji's blood.

He looked up, directly facing a pair of bottomless eyes—Ling Yuan. The old man stood with hands behind his back, looking nothing like an uninvited guest, but rather the true master of this secret chamber.

"Unfortunately, you came too early."

choices.text: Use the Tianji Record to peer into the future of this place
choices.description: If Ling Yuan is secretly monitoring this secret chamber, the Tianji Record might glimpse the dangerous developments ahead. But this means consuming precious Heavenly Fate...
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate -5, and may be detected by the Heavenly Secrets Eye

text.content:
Chen Ji did not act rashly.

He quietly activated the Tianji Record Fragment, and a wisp of clear consciousness delved into that void of causal sea. After a moment, his brow center twitched slightly—

The vision emerged: at the secret chamber entrance, three black shadows secretly set up a Soul-Locking Formation; Ling Yuan would appear from the shadows, killing him on the spot under the pretense of "purging the sect"; and the jade pendant engraved with the character "Ji" in his hand would become irrefutable evidence of his crime—"stealing sect secrets, intending to defect."

What a masterful frame-up.

Chen Ji withdrew his consciousness, a mocking curve forming at the corner of his lips. Old fox, as expected, he did not disappoint. He tucked the notes and the heirlooms from the hidden compartment into his chest, then—

Walked toward an inconspicuous rune formation in the corner of the secret chamber.

If his father could set up this secret chamber, would he not have left an escape route?

Chen Ji carefully traced along the four walls of the secret chamber and finally found a depression beneath the rune formation in the southeast corner. It was an extremely hidden escape tunnel entrance, impossible to discover without the Tianji Record's foresight.

The moment he pressed his palm against the depression—

The stone door of the secret chamber slammed shut.

The eternal lamp went out, plunging everything into absolute darkness. A familiar pressure assaulted him from behind, carrying the same hypocritical kindness that had not changed in ten years.

"Ji'er, you have disappointed your father greatly."

Ling Yuan's voice emerged from the darkness, like a specter's whisper. Chen Ji slowly turned around, directly facing those bottomless eyes—now utterly devoid of pretense, leaving only a居高临下的scrutinizing与毫不掩饰的murderous。

"I thought you could stay content and be atrash for a lifetime. But unexpectedly... you wanted to imitate your foolish father."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji静静看着眼前这张熟悉的面孔，心中十年积压的恨意与此刻的calm形成诡异的平衡。

他忽然笑了。

"蠢？"他轻声重复这个字，语调calm得近乎残忍，"凌掌门当年在父亲面前跪地求饶的时候，是不是也觉得他很蠢？"

凌渊的眼神suddenly凌厉起来。

"你——"

"父亲把一切都写下来了。"陈机从怀中取出那本绢帛册子，在指尖轻轻晃了晃，"包括凌掌门是如何被天机之眼选中，又是如何出卖自己的灵魂换取延寿秘法。父亲发现真相的那一夜，凌掌门一定很害怕吧？"

text.content:
Ling Yuan's expression彻底gloomy下来。

那张维持了十年的慈和面具在这一刻碎裂殆尽，露出下面狰狞的真容。他盯着陈机手中的绢帛，眼中murderous几乎凝成实质。

"你以为凭这些东西，就能动得了我？"老人sneered一声，"天真。你父亲当年手握的证据比这多十倍，最后又如何？走火入魔、暴毙身亡——这便是与本座作对的下场。"

他向前踏出一步，浩瀚的灵压如山岳倾轧而下。

"把东西交出来，本座可以让你死得体面些。"

Chen Ji感受着那股令人窒息的灵压，脊背却挺得笔直。

他知道自己不是凌渊的对手。哪怕对方年事已高，哪怕他这三年来暗中积累了不少底牌，在绝对的实力差距面前，一切阴谋诡计都是笑话。

但他从未打算在这里与凌渊硬碰硬。

"凌掌门就这么有confident，能留住我？"他忽然开口，语气中带着一丝meaningful的笑意。

凌渊眉头微皱："你以为那条老鼠洞能救你？本座布下的锁灵阵——"

"锁灵阵？"陈机轻笑出声，"凌掌门不如回头看看，您布下的那些阵旗……还在吗？"

凌渊abruptly回头。

只见密室入口处，三道黑影正无声倒下，而在他们身旁，一盏幽绿色的鬼火正静静燃烧——那是魔道特有的灭迹手法。

夜清。

她果然来了。

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji seized the moment when Ling Yuan was distracted and slipped into the hidden escape tunnel.

Behind him came Ling Yuan's furious roar: "Chen Ji——! You cannot escape! The Heavenly Secrets Eye has already noticed you, do you think a mere demonic path witch can protect you?!"

Chen Ji did not look back.

He raced through the narrow passage, his mind racing with calculations. Ling Yuan was right—the Heavenly Secrets Eye had already set its sights on him. From the moment he obtained the Tianji Record Fragment, he was destined to be unable to stay low-profile.

But the greatest gain tonight was not escaping pursuit.

It was his father's legacy—the jade pendant engraved with the character "Ji," and the unopened letter.

"Father... what else did you leave me?"

text.content:
The tunnel's end was a deserted mountain crevice, night wind pouring in with the fragrance of grass and trees.

The moment Chen Ji squeezed out sideways, a black figure had been waiting.

"Three breaths faster than I expected." Ye Qing's voice came from the darkness, carrying a lazy smile, "Did the old Ling not pursue?"

"He's still in the secret chamber." Chen Ji brushed dust off his clothes, "Did you deal with his men?"

"Just three Jindan Stage wastes." Ye Qing answered carelessly, but her gaze fell on the bulging position in Chen Ji's chest, "Did you find it?"

Chen Ji nodded, then after a moment of silence asked, "You knew all along what was in the secret chamber?"

Ye Qing did not answer, only turning toward the mountain path, leaving behind a meaningful words:

"Your father came to me back then. He knew the secret of the Tianji Record... and he knew my situation. He asked me to give you some things at the appropriate time."

"What things?"

Ye Qing stopped, turned to look at him, her emerald-green eyes gleaming in the night:

"The letter in your hand... is only the first one."

choice.prompt: Ye Qing's words made Chen Ji's heart一震—his father had actually had contact with the Holy Sect Saintess, and seemed to have left multiple letters. This meant his father's布局 was far deeper and more extensive than imagined. But he had just escaped Ling Yuan's pursuit—should he immediately press Ye Qing for more details?

choices.description: The letter had burned in his chest for too long. His father's handwritten words might answer many of his doubts at this moment.
choices.visible_reward: Gain key guidance from Father's testament
choices.risk_hint: If Ling Yuan's pursuers catch up, may fall into a passive situation
choices.process_label: chen ji finds hidden cave, uses ye qing's ghost fire to unfold father's last letter

text.content:
Chen Ji展开那封泛黄的信笺，在山洞中。

父亲的字迹映入眼帘，苍劲中透着几分颤抖，显然是在极度weak的状态下写就：

"机儿，若你读到此信，说明为父已不在人世。天机录选中你，并非偶然——你是唯一能斩断天机枷锁的人。为父穷尽一生寻找的破局之法，就藏在天机录第七页的夹层中。那是慕容青城留下的秘法，也是唯一能对抗天机之眼的手段。

但切记，在集齐至少三页残页之前，切勿尝试。否则，必死无疑。

为父没能护住你妹妹，是我此生最大的遗憾。若有一日你能找到她……告诉她，父亲爱她。"

陈机握着信笺的手slightly颤抖。他深吸一口气，将信小心收好。

"第七页……三页残页……"他whispered呢喃，眼中精光闪烁，"父亲，你到底还藏了多少秘密？"

choices.text: Question Ye Qing for more details
choices.description: Ye Qing clearly knows more about the situation. Why would Father have approached the Holy Sect Saintess back then? What kind of deal did they make? The answers to these questions may be crucial to the next moves.
choices.visible_cost: May cross Ye Qing's bottom line
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may be holding back

dialogue.content:
"What else do you know?" Chen Ji stepped in front of Ye Qing, his voice calm yet brooking no evasion.

Ye Qing raised an eyebrow, regarding him with a knowing half-smile. "Bold of you to ask."

"When my father approached you back then, it wasn't just to have you deliver a letter." Chen Ji met those eerie green eyes directly. "What else did he say?"

Ye Qing fell silent for a moment, her smile gradually fading.

"Your father..." She paused, as if searching for the right words. "He was the first human cultivator I'd ever met who knew my circumstances yet still chose to treat me as an equal in trade. He told me that the Eye of Heavenly Secrets doesn't just control the Tianqing Sect—it controls the entire cultivation world. He needed an insider, and I... needed a契机 to break the Holy Sect's shackles."

"So you cooperated?"

"Cooperated?" Ye Qing snorted with disdain. "He provided the methods; I provided cover. Each taking what they needed. Nothing more." She turned away, her voice suddenly dropping. "Unfortunately... he died too early."

flags_set: 得知父亲与夜清的交易

text.content:
Night wind whistled through cracks in the mountain walls, carrying mournful sounds.

Chen Ji tucked his father's testament letter close to his chest, his thoughts churning like a tide. The Tianji Record's seventh page insert, the threshold of three fragments, the secret method to counter the Eye of Heavenly Secrets... At the final moments of his life, his father was still paving the way for him.

And Ling Yuan—that old fox who played the role of saint for ten years, the true killer of his father—must now be raging in his secret chamber.

At this thought, Chen Ji's lips curved slightly upward.

Today's grudge, he recorded it. Not that he wouldn't retaliate—the time simply hadn't come. Once he gathered all three fragments and mastered the secret method to counter the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, that would be Ling Yuan's death day.

"Let's go," he said to Ye Qing. "The old man Ling won't let this slide. We need to leave here quickly."

Ye Qing nodded, about to turn, when her expression suddenly changed. "Someone's coming."

Chen Ji focused his senses, his pupils contracting sharply—that aura was all too familiar.

Su Qingyao.

The Inner Sect Senior Fellow was racing toward this location.

Under the moonlight, a white-robed figure arrived like a startled swan.

Su Qingyao landed at the cave entrance, her sword still sheathed, but those cold, clear eyes had already locked onto Chen Ji. Her expression was complex—scrutiny, doubt, and something like... concern?

"Chen Ji." Her voice was like icy spring water, crisp and clear. "You left the Servants' Quarters late at night, destination unknown. The sect patrol disciples detected spiritual energy fluctuations near Chen Xuan's old residence—give me an explanation."

Chen Ji watched her quietly, a complicated emotion rising in his heart.

This woman... was his most dangerous opponent, yet also the most likely ally. She was brilliant, her intuition sharp, having come close to the truth three times. If she discovered his collusion with the Demonic Path Saint, the consequences would be unimaginable.

But at the same time, her position was so delicate—she was a Tianqing Sect disciple, yet never fawned over power; she held high rank, yet treated thistrash servant with special regard.

"Senior Sister Su." He spoke, his voice calm as still water. "This matter... is a long story."

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's sudden appearance made the situation delicate. She was the Inner Sect Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect. If she discovered his collusion with the Demonic Path Saint, she would be caught in a dilemma. Chen Ji needed to find a balance between preserving his life, maintaining the alliance with the Demonic Path, and not revealing too many trump cards.

choices.text: Honestly reveal part of the truth to Su Qingyao
choices.description: Su Qingyao is brilliant; lies are hard to deceive her. It would be better to reveal part of the truth—his father's death, Ling Yuan's conspiracy—in exchange for her trust and cooperation.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing weaknesses may cause loss of initiative
choices.visible_reward: Gain initial trust from Su Qingyao
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may not be able to accept it, or may report to the sect
choices.process_label: chen ji signals ye qing to retreat, then stares into su qingyao's eyes

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji signaled Ye Qing to hide in the shadows for now, then turned to Su Qingyao, his voice extremely low:

"Does Senior Sister Su still remember what happened the night my sister disappeared three years ago?"

Su Qingyao frowned slightly. "Why are you suddenly bringing this up?"

"That night, someone saw her being taken away by people from the Holy Sect." Chen Ji paused. "And the one who orchestrated all this... was Patriarch Ling."

Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply.

"What did you say?"

"I went to my father's old residence tonight to search for the keepsakes he left behind." Chen Ji took out the silk booklet from his chest. "If Senior Sister Su doesn't believe me, you may look yourself. But I can only let you see it for three breaths—this thing must never be known to a third person."

Su Qingyao took the booklet, quickly scanning several lines of text. Her face instantly turned pale.

choices.text: Use the useless persona to fob her off
choices.description: Before determining Su Qingyao's stance, he absolutely cannot reveal anything easily. Ye Qing is still nearby—if they're discovered appearing together at the same time, even jumping into the Yellow River won't wash away the suspicion.

choices.visible_reward: Preserve the alliance with Ye Qing
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao already suspects; may deepen the investigation
choices.process_label: chen ji puts on familiar weak expression, hunching back, avoiding su qingyao's scrutinizing gaze

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji lowered his head, shoulders slightly trembling, the perfect image of a man whose courage had been shattered.

"S-Senior Sister Su, I just couldn't sleep and came out for some fresh air..." His voice was barely a whisper. "I don't know anything about any spiritual energy fluctuations, I really don't know anything..."

Su Qingyao coldly watched him, a flash of disappointment flickering in her eyes.

"Chen Ji, do you take me for a fool?" She stepped forward, closing in on Chen Ji. "The night clothes you're wearing, your companion's aura, whatever you're hiding in your chest—you think I can't see any of it?"

Chen Ji still kept his head lowered, but beneath those drooping eyelids, his gaze was deep and profound as an abyss.

"If Senior Sister Su insists on searching, then... then Chen Ji submits." He continued in that cowardly tone. "It's just that after the search, what do you plan to do with me? Report to the Patriarch? Say the disciple went out at night with ulterior motives?"

Su Qingyao's body stiffened slightly.

She knew what he was implying—if she reported to Ling Yuan, her investigation results would be controlled by that man; if she didn't report, she would be derelict in her duty. Either path, she would be trapped.

text.content:
Just as the standoff僵持, Ye Qing's figure suddenly emerged from the shadows.

"Had enough chat?" Her lips carried a playful smile. "If you don't leave now, Patriarch Ling's people will be catching up."

Su Qingyao spun around, sword light flashing as she prepared to strike. But the next instant, her body froze in place—a诡异 black mist was surging from all directions, enveloping her entirely.

"Demonic Path Mist..." she ground out through clenched teeth. "Chen Ji, how dare you—"

"Senior Sister Su, my apologies." Chen Ji's voice drifted from within the black mist,calm得没有一丝波澜. "There are some things I still cannot let you know. But I can guarantee you one thing—I will not betray the Tianqing Sect. As for the rest..."

He paused, his tone carrying the first hint of sincere regret:

"The day I get to the bottom of the truth, I will tell you myself."

The black mist gradually dissipated. Su Qingyao found herself trapped in a simple Spirit-Locking Formation, while Chen Ji and Ye Qing's figures had long vanished into the night.

Moonlight like frost, sprinkling on the desolate mountain path.

Chen Ji and Ye Qing walked side by side at a swift pace, neither speaking. After a long while, Ye Qing finally spoke:

"That senior sister of yours... she has feelings for you."

Chen Ji's footsteps faltered for a moment before continuing. "You're overthinking."

"Are you?" Ye Qing gave a light laugh. "The Demonic Path's Soul-Tracking is absolute for reading emotions. The way she looks at you, the emotional fluctuations were so intense it made me blush for her."

Chen Ji didn't respond.

He thought of Su Qingyao's gaze just now—scrutiny, doubt, but more than that, something he himself was unwilling to acknowledge.

"She's very dangerous." He ultimately only said these three words.

"Yes," Ye Qing's tone carried deep meaning. "That's why she's even more intriguing. What do you plan to do with her?"

Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then said:

"When she figures out Ling Yuan's true colors, she'll make her own choice."

Just as the two were about to reach safe ground, Chen Ji suddenly stopped.

Ye Qing surveyed the surroundings alertly. "What's wrong?"

"Someone's here." Chen Ji's voice suddenly tensed.

Under the moonlight, a hunched figure stood in the middle of the mountain path. It was an old man, shrouded in gray mist, his features so blurred they were nearly invisible.

But when Chen Ji recognized those eyes, his pupils contracted sharply—

Those were eyes infinitely familiar to him.

His father's handwriting, his father's aura, all the clues his father left behind... at this moment, they converged into a fact that made his whole body go cold.

"Ji'er." The old man spoke, his voice aged yet gentle. "You've finally reached this point."

Chen Ji stared死死 at that blurred face, his voice hoarse and nearly distorted:

"Who... who are you?"

The old man's lips curved slightly upward, revealing a meaningful smile:

"I am your father's guardian, and also... the guide of the Tianji Record."

"You may call me—Mo Xiansheng."
